# `r cv_section_icon("chalkboard-teacher")` Presentations

## Workshops and Organised Sessions

```{r workshops}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

workshops <- tribble(
  ~ Title, ~ Year, ~ Conference, ~ Who,
  "Space Oddity: Thinking About Ecological Networks Across Space", "Aug., 2022", "ESA/CSEE Meeting","Francis Banville, Gabriel Dansereau, *Tanya Strydom*",
  "Designing a collective prototype of future tropical and subtropical science", "Jul., 2021", "ATBC Annual Meeting","Gracielle Higino, Mickey Boakye, Norma Forero, *Tanya Strydom*"
)

cv_entries(workshops, with = "Title", when = "Year",
           what = "Who", where = "Conference")

```

## Invited talks and seminars

```{r invited}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

invites <- tribble(
  ~ Title, ~ Year, ~ Conference, ~ Who,
    "Take a Byte: How the (En)Codification of Food Webs Impacts Inference","Oct., 2026", "Theoretical Ecology Seminar Series", "*Tanya Strydom*",
    "How do you Reconstruct a Food Web that Died 200 million Years Ago?","Oct., 2026", "Yorkshire Geological Society", "*Tanya Strydom*",
    "The Risks and Rewards of Large Language Models in (Open) Scientific Research","Oct., 2025", "SORTEE", "*Tanya Strydom*",
    "What's [complexity] got to do with it?","Jul., 2023", "NetSci 2023", "*Tanya Strydom*",
  "Making something out of nothing at all: Transfer learning for network prediction","Apr., 2022", "ML4MS mini-conference", "*Tanya Strydom*",
 "Taking FAIR and open science to the field: The evolution of the PFTC field course","Oct., 2020", "Living Norway Colloquium", "*Tanya Strydom* alongside Aud H. Halbritter, 109 PFTC Participants",
)

cv_entries(invites, with = "Title", when = "Year",
           what = "Who", where = "Conference")

```

## **Talks**

```{r talks}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

talks <- tribble(
  ~ Title, ~ Year, ~ Conference, ~ Who,
  "It's okay to be different: Understanding how and why network construction matters", "July, 2025", "4th CPEG Symposium", "\textbf{Tanya Strydom}",
  "Exploring the complexity of ecological networks using SVD entropy", "Dec., 2020", "11th Annual QCBS Symposium", "\textbf{Tanya Strydom}, Giulio V. Dalla Riva and Timothée Poisot",
)

cv_entries(talks, with = "Title", when = "Year",
           what = "Who", where = "Conference")

```
